ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 70:30 light-to-dark pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white/light-grey central regions across both lobes; contiguous black/low-intensity pigmentation along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; irregular black mottling and focal clusters distributed throughout the light areas, particularly dense on the left lobe proximal to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle approximately 75 degrees; depth extends significantly into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire continuous linear boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from shallow indentations to prominent jagged peaks, isolated from the high-contrast water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex sweep along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to sharp upward trajectories toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped dark pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the white surface, with a notable concentration of high-contrast rings on the mid-right lobe and inner-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark vertical and diagonal linear streaks visible on the left lobe, cutting through the primary white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent yellowish-brown textured protrusion (barnacle colony) on the distal tip of the left lobe; visible irregular tissue loss/jagged serrations along the trailing edge consistent with physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: The dense, three-dimensional biological growth cluster localized specifically on the upper-most tip of the left lobe.
